analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 43.3 exiting oversold and continuing to consolidate in neutral zone. MACD histogram improving but still negative. ADX at 21.6 in early trend formation, lacking direction. Closed at $369.68, slightly down -0.18% over 5 days, above SMA200 ($368.72) but below SMA20 ($387.54). The 'hold' stance for 15 consecutive sessions, with a -3.3% drawdown, has been effective defense, but adding leverage requires observation. Approaching swing support at $369.51.
